units.translation: Thus Wieseler for ἐφεζομένη [sitting upon]. These are forms of the aorist ἐφεζόμην [I sat upon], as was said under ἐνέζεσθαι [to be seated in].
And saving fortune sat upon the ship, willing it.
δυσφόρως [grievously]? The aorist ἐπέσπον [I followed] is not found elsewhere in the tragedians, but it is found in Homer Il. 19, 294.
